scoring_justification: All target quantities (η, d, ω⊥², ωx1², ωx2², gap) are recomputed from the agent's own reported material parameters, enabling a full T1 recompute without trusting self-reported numbers.

hidden_assets.purpose: Order-of-magnitude gap range (1e10 s⁻¹ to 1e11 s⁻¹) from the paper's numerical estimate.
hidden_assets.source_provenance: Paper section 3 last paragraph: 'величина энергетической щели ... может достигать 10^{10}-10^{11} c^{-1}'. Values chosen as the exact stated interval.
hidden_assets.generation_method: Direct extraction from the paper text; the endpoints are used as a range gate with tolerance.
hidden_assets.why_not_fabricated: The numbers are taken verbatim from the paper's published claim; they are not invented.

outputs.description: Static domain wall profile properties and material parameters. The checker recomputes η, d, and ω⊥² from the provided parameters, checks self-consistency within 1e-6 relative tolerance, and verifies that the computed gap derived in the next step falls in the expected range.

Localized mode frequencies squared and energy gap squared. The checker recomputes these quantities from the parameters in step_01 and compares them to the reported values with a tight tolerance, then checks that the absolute gap Δω = sqrt(omega_perp_sq) - sqrt(omega_x1_sq) lies in the physically expected order-of-magnitude range for BaTiO₃.

output_contract.notes: The agent must choose typical BaTiO3 parameters that satisfy the paper's scaling relations and yield a gap within the stated order-of-magnitude range. No thin-wall results are required.

steps.description: Recompute η, d, ω⊥² from the agent-reported parameters and check self-consistency with tightly reported values. Full credit if all relative errors ≤ 1e-6.

Recompute ωx1², ωx2² from step_01 parameters; verify consistency with agent's reported frequencies and gap_sq, enforce positivity & ordering, and check that the absolute gap Δω=√(ω⊥²)−√(ωx1²) lies in [1e10, 1e11] s⁻¹. Full credit if all consistency/ordering pass and gap in range.
